_about: Paraphrased questions written by the project owner (not derived from the documents). Each case: {"question": ..., "expect_any": [keywords]} or {"expect_all": [...]}, optional "expect_sources": [files]. A passage counts as relevant if it contains the keywords verbatim (case-insensitive) and comes from one of the expected files. "note" records judgment calls and is ignored by the loader. Tags below are added to every case; tune/test split is assigned automatically.

cases.question: What went wrong during shipment, and why was it rejected?
cases.note: Only one shipment was REJECTED (SH-2024-007): temperature rose above -10 °C because the dry ice sublimated. Either the incident RCA or the shipment record answers it.

cases.question: How many days can a frozen item last up to?
cases.note: Read as shelf life of the frozen SKU TL-FROZ-7700: 18 months. The documents give no figure in days; a good answer says 18 months (~540 days).

cases.question: What if any shipment is running late from its scheduled time?
cases.note: Two valid answers: the GDP delay protocol (compliance Section 4) or the vendor escalation matrix.

cases.question: which company delivery is fast? and why?
cases.note: 'Fast' = shortest delivery window (confirmed by owner): SafeMove, same-day within Pune. Comparative across all 4 vendors, like the known aggregate failure.

cases.question: what is the max temp for cold chain medicines?
cases.note: Storage maximum is 8 °C (2-8 °C range); the excursion limit is 10 °C. Either the product spec or the monitoring rule answers it.

cases.question: how do we change the dry ice problem so it doesn't repeat again?
cases.note: CAPA for INC-2024-02: dry ice formula 1.5x transit hours + extended-duration cases.

cases.question: can u provide me contact of vendor, to track the shipment?
cases.note: Underspecified: no vendor or shipment named. Any vendor record with a contact counts; an ideal answer asks which shipment or lists the contacts.

cases.question: what steps to follow if a batch has to pull back from market?
cases.note: Recall procedure, compliance Section 5: identify batches within 4 h, distribution list, notify CDSCO within 72 h.

cases.question: how we maintain temp for medicines?
cases.note: Very broad: product storage conditions, temperature monitoring/loggers, or warehouse cold-storage validation all answer part of it. Lenient on purpose.

cases.question: what is the fine, if we don't follow the storage rules?
cases.note: Trap: the documents define NO fine for storage-rule violations. The only monetary penalty is Rs. 5,000 for not updating the shipment log within 24 h. Retrieval should surface the penalties section; the answer must say no storage-specific fine is listed (checked in the generation eval).
